integrity: Exact exhaustive finite lattice enumeration with a proved cutoff and standalone integer/rational arithmetic verifier; source theorems credited, not independently re-proved.
scientific_limitations: Applies to the explicit smooth elliptic K3 specialization F^(4)_{E_2,E_5}; relies on Kumar--Kuwata full geometric Mordell--Weil basis and Burek specialized height matrix. Only zero-disjoint sections and the shortest-section graph are classified; equivalent unindexed lattice theta computations remain possible.
title: The 1,212 zero-disjoint sections and a 204-section intersection spectrum on an elliptic K3
